proof_body:
by
  have hne : ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → z + Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz h
    have := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp at this
    linarith
  constructor
  · intro z hz
    have hp : 0 < ‖z + Complex.I‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hne z hz)
    rw [norm_div, div_lt_one hp]
    have id : ‖z + Complex.I‖ ^ 2 - ‖z - Complex.I‖ ^ 2 = 4 * z.im := by
      simp only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
      simp
      ring
    exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 hp.le (by linarith)
  · intro w hw
    have h1 : (1 : ℂ) - w ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have : w = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
      rw [this] at hw
      simp at hw
    set z0 : ℂ := Complex.I * (1 + w) / (1 - w) with hz0
    have him : 0 < z0.im := by
      have e : z0 = Complex.I * ((1 + w) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (1 - w)) / ((Complex.normSq (1 - w) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        rw [hz0, Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
        have h2 : (starRingEnd ℂ) (1 - w) ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero _).mpr h1
        field_simp
      have hpos : 0 < Complex.normSq (1 - w) := Complex.normSq_pos.mpr h1
      rw [e, Complex.div_ofReal_im]
      apply div_pos _ hpos
      have hsq : w.re * w.re + w.im * w.im < 1 := by
        have := (Complex.sq_norm w ▸ (pow_lt_one₀ (norm_nonneg w) hw two_ne_zero))
        rw [Complex.normSq_apply] at this
        exact this
      simp
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨z0, ⟨him, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have h2 := hne z0 him
      have h3 : z0 + Complex.I = 2 * Complex.I / (1 - w) := by
        rw [hz0]; field_simp; ring
      have h4 : z0 - Complex.I = 2 * Complex.I * w / (1 - w) := by
        rw [hz0]; field_simp; ring
      rw [h3, h4]
      have h5 : (2 * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := by simp
      field_simp
    · rintro y ⟨hy, hye⟩
      have h2 := hne y hy
      rw [div_eq_iff h2] at hye
      rw [hz0, eq_div_iff h1]
      linear_combination hye
target_source: (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → ‖(z - Complex.I) / (z + Complex.I)‖ < 1) ∧ ∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < 1 → ∃! z : ℂ, 0 < z.im ∧ (z - Complex.I) / (z + Complex.I) = w
